backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing invoices, payments, user profiles, and role-based access control with admin‑only data upload/clear and user payment entry.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing features, affected files, components, and test IDs for onboarding and role-handling behavior.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries for major frontend files describing routing, UI components, hooks, pages, and utilities.
frontend/docs/publish-live.md: Go‑live checklist covering authentication, feature validation, UX checks, data integrity, and known limitations.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light/dark theme variables and base styling.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML file loading the React application entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React router configuration handling authentication state, role-based routing, and page layout.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: UI screen shown when a user lacks permission, with navigation back to home.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Profile setup modal allowing users to save name and role or skip, with backend persistence and cache invalidation.
Shows a dismissible alert prompting the user to complete their profile and opens a setup modal.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Defines the main app layout with navigation, user info, logout handling, mobile menu, and optional profile setup prompt.
frontend/src/components/payments/Payment: Provides a form UI to add, remove, and edit multiple payment mode entries.
frontend/src/components/reports/ReportsF: Renders filters for reports including date range, salesman, payment type, and payment mode.
frontend/src/components/reports/Retailer: Displays payments grouped by retailer with totals and a detailed table per retailer.
frontend/src/components/tables/InvoicesT: Displays paginated invoices with ageing-day sorting, status badges, and navigation actions.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor based on identity, initializing access control and invalidating dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUser.ts: Fetches current user profile and role via react-query using an actor, exposing loading state and admin flag.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, managing identity loading, login, logout, and status states using AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines react-query hooks for invoices and payments, plus mutations for uploading, clearing, adding, and editing data.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminDashboardP: Admin dashboard showing key financial stats and navigation cards using report data.
frontend/src/pages/admin/RawDataUploadPa: Admin page for uploading, clearing, searching, and filtering invoice data with table display.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login screen using Internet Identity with a styled UI and login status handling.
frontend/src/pages/payments/EditPaymentE: Provides a form to edit an existing payment entry, loading payment data and submitting updates via mutation.
frontend/src/pages/payments/PaymentEntry: Handles creation of new payment entries for an invoice, validating lines and submitting multiple payments based on modes.
frontend/src/pages/payments/PaymentHisto: Displays a retailer’s payment history with formatting helpers and optional admin edit actions.
frontend/src/pages/reports/ReportsPage.t: Fetches and displays payment report data with filters, summary stats, and CSV export.
frontend/src/types/payment.ts: Defines the PaymentLine interface representing individual payment input fields.
frontend/src/utils/excel/parseInvoicesXl: Parses CSV-like XLSX uploads into Invoice objects, validating required columns and balance amounts.
frontend/src/utils/export/exportReportsT: Generates and downloads a CSV report from aggregated payment data and filters.
frontend/src/utils/export/invoiceUploadT: Downloads a blank invoice upload CSV template containing all required headers.
frontend/src/utils/filtering/invoiceFilt: Provides a filter function that returns invoices matching optional retailer, invoice, and salesman criteria.
frontend/src/utils/invoices/ageingDays.t: Parses invoice date strings, calculates ageing days relative to today, and formats the result.
frontend/src/utils/invoices/normalizeInv: Normalizes various invoice status formats into consistent status keys.
frontend/src/utils/payments/paymentStatu: Calculates total, remaining, and excess payment amounts and derives payment status labels.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Gets URL or session-stored parameters and manages persistence and cleanup of session parameters.
frontend/src/utils/validation/paymentEnt: Validates payment entry lines, ensuring required fields and positive amounts per payment mode.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom colors, typography, container settings, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing scope, architecture notes, known issues, and implemented features.
